map.计算 FEV1/FVC 比值判定阻塞性通气障碍，并按 GOLD 标准（FEV1: Compute the FEV1/FVC ratio to identify obstructive ventilatory defect and grade severity by GOLD criteria (FEV1 percent predicted).
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：fev1÷fev1pred×100；fvc÷fvcp: Core formula (by input variable): fev1/fev1pred*100; fvc/fvcpred*100; ratio*100
map.📖 查看「肺功能（FEV1/FVC）分级 使用指南」: 📖 View the Pulmonary Function (FEV1/FVC) Grading user guide
map.FEV1/FVC 比值：正常 ≥ 0.70（高龄可略低）；< 0.70 提示阻塞: FEV1/FVC ratio: normal >= 0.70 (may be slightly lower in the elderly); < 0.70 suggests obstructive ventilatory defect.
map.GOLD 分级（阻塞性时按 FEV1%预计值）：GOLD 1 轻 ≥80%；GO: GOLD grading (by FEV1% predicted when obstructive): GOLD 1 mild >=80%; GOLD 2 moderate 50-79%; GOLD 3 severe 30-49%; GOLD 4 very severe <30%.
map.FVC < 预计值 80% 提示限制性通气障碍可能。: FVC < 80% predicted suggests a possible restrictive ventilatory defect.
map.FEV1%预计值 = 实测 FEV1 ÷ 预计 FEV1 × 100%。: FEV1% predicted = measured FEV1 / predicted FEV1 x 100%.
map.⚠️ 结果需结合支气管舒张试验、肺活量、弥散功能综合判断。本工具不替代专业肺功能: Results must be combined with bronchodilator testing, vital capacity and diffusion capacity. This tool does not replace a professional pulmonary function report.

map.比值=2.1/3.5=60%，<60 岁 LLN 0.70→阻塞性；FEV₁%p: Ratio = 2.1/3.5 = 60%, LLN 0.70 for age <60 -> obstructive; FEV1%pred = 2.1/3.0 = 70% -> GOLD 2 moderate.
map.若 FVC<预计值 80%：比值低且 FVC 低→混合性或限制性，需查 TLC/: If FVC < 80% predicted: low ratio plus low FVC -> mixed or restrictive; check TLC/DLCO.
map.年轻用 LLN 更准，老年常用 0.70；本工具按年龄取 LLN，≥65 用 0: LLN is more accurate in the young, 0.70 is common in the elderly; this tool uses age-based LLN, 0.66 for age >=65.
